record.notes: The cover gives the year 2025; the document-control table gives May 2025, document type 'Regulatory Documents', document number SDAIA-P119 and version number 2, so an earlier version exists; the text describes the regulatory landscape as of June 2024. Its recommendations cite SDAIA's AI Ethics Principles (SA-01), the Personal Data Protection Law and the Anti-Cyber Crime Law, and it refers to SDAIA's generative AI guidelines for the public (SA-02). An appendix provides for ongoing review with periodic stakeholder feedback. SDAIA lists the document among its laws and regulations under 'Deepfakes Guidelines'.

verification.note: Recheck of 18 Oct 2026. Stored: the English PDF from sdaia.gov.sa (56 pages) and SDAIA's laws and regulations page (snapshots of 11 Oct 2026, unchanged on 18 Oct 2026). The PDF confirms the title, May 2025, version 2, document number SDAIA-P119 and the guidance summarised; its text does not name the issuer, which rests on the SDAIA document number and on SDAIA's page listing it. The date of version 1 is in no stored source. The Arabic edition is not stored.
